Punjab to Recruit Over 1,000 Patwaris, Ending Strike

Punjab Chief Minister Bhagwant Mann has directed officials to begin the process of recruiting over 1,000 revenue patwaris. Following this assurance, the Patwar Union has called off its strike. The recruitment aims to fill more than 1,000 positions.
